steps.en: Officer opens a search for outstanding notices to reduce
steps.id: Officer membuka pencarian notice outstanding untuk di-reduce
steps.why_en: Only a general outstanding-notice search exists; the Fine Reduction screen is switched off in the staff portal.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pencarian outstanding umum; layar Fine Reduction dimatikan di portal staff.

steps.en: Search by notice number and ID number
steps.id: Cari memakai notice number dan ID number
steps.why_en: The outstanding search has ID but no notice number field; notice number exists only in the all-notices search.
steps.why_id: Pencarian outstanding punya ID tapi tanpa kolom notice number; notice number hanya ada di pencarian semua notice.

steps.why_en: Stage is only a result column in the outstanding search; the stage filter exists only in the all-notices search.
steps.why_id: Stage hanya kolom hasil di pencarian outstanding; filter stage hanya ada di pencarian semua notice.

steps.en: The matching notices are shown on screen
steps.id: Notice yang cocok ditampilkan di layar
